active_product_bottleneck.observation: The >9.33 MB Office byte breakthrough remains robust, but the final bounded Python execution-architecture frame review failed. Exact head 240b4adb / artifact 10788846807 preserved 9,334,246 B product-matrix median saving and 9,334,240 B resource-gate saving with RSS 1.00x and faster selective reads, but create regressed to 1.45444x and extract measured 1.11243x. Four-worker staging therefore worsened the already-reproduced serial ~1.35x plateau instead of crossing the frozen 1.25x max-workload ceiling.
active_product_bottleneck.next_discriminator: Retire Python-local create rehabilitation. Reopen the representation/ownership boundary: test a first-class physical exact-Deflate identity/source design aligned with r25 authenticated physical payload organization, so exact compressed payloads can be owned/authenticated/read without repeatedly materializing logical members or inheriting r24 whole-logical mode0 authentication.

primary_question.hypothesis: The remaining cost is structural: r24 Builder ownership is logical-content-first while the byte win is exact-physical-stream-first. A useful next design must make authenticated physical Deflate identity first-class and converge with r25 locality rather than continue serial/parallel staging tweaks.

primary_question.kill: Do not spend another product cycle on Python serial/parallel staging, proof caching, worker-count gardening or threshold changes. The next experiment must alter physical identity/ownership or authenticated physical organization and must preserve exactness, >9 MB headroom, bounded admission, <=8x selective decoded/reconstructed work, RSS <=1.25x and frozen runtime law.
